summary: Complete testing of Profile API and AI Suggestions API with GPT-4o integration. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend pages (Profile, Trading Journal Dashboard, Exit Simulator) verified working correctly with AI-powered features.
passed_tests: GET /api/profile/{wallet_address} - creates new profile with game stats if not exists
GET /api/profile/{wallet_address} - returns existing profile on subsequent calls
PUT /api/profile/{wallet_address} - updates social links (twitter, telegram, discord, website)
GET /api/profile/{wallet_address}/skins - returns owned skins with default skin always available
POST /api/ai-suggestions/exit-simulator - returns GPT-4o powered trading suggestions
GET /api/ai-suggestions/journal-daily/{wallet_address} - returns GPT-4o powered daily insights
GET /api/ai-suggestions/journal-daily/{wallet_address} - works for users with/without trading history
AI suggestions include journal context when wallet_address provided
Live price fetch integration works (CoinGecko API)
Profile page renders with 'Connect Wallet' when not connected
Trading Journal Dashboard tab renders with stats, metrics, and charts (Cumulative P&L, P&L by Asset)
Exit Simulator page renders with parameters form (tokens, entry price, volatility, drift, days, simulations, tax rate)
Exit Simulator Monte Carlo simulation runs correctly with 1000 simulations
AI Suggestion Bubble appears after simulation with personalized trading insights
seed_data_creation: Test profiles created during testing with unique wallet addresses (test-wallet-*, new-profile-*, etc.)
